moments_proposed.note: There is no game.json yet. These are proposed moments, each one an achievement already in the build (ACH in hub.js). Nothing new was added to the game. The build has 16; these 12 are proposed, and Bought a bomb, One dollar, Paper hat and Snoop are left out.
